item.title: The Line Divides revisit ‘90s Cebu in comeback single ‘Nobenta’ — listen
item.description: The Line Divides are back, and they’re bringing Cebu’s golden decade with them. ‘Nobenta’ is the band’s first new track since 2021’s ‘Destiny’ and a love letter to growing up in 1990s Cebu. The single blends warm synths, a touch of pop-punk soul, and heavy nostalgia — complete with lyrical nods to Wham, cassette tapes, and the iconic Weekly Top 40. item.title: RIIZE’s Anton & Sohee join Minister Edwin Tong at SM Universe Singapore opening ceremony
item.description: SM Entertainment has officially opened SM Universe Singapore, marking the company’s first K-pop training academy outside South Korea and a major step in expanding its global talent development pipeline. Located along Orchard Road at *SCAPE, SM Universe Singapore first soft-launched in June 2025 and has since rolled out more than 70 programmes, training over 600 students from more than 10 countries. item.title: Chinese rap sensation GAI is bringing his 'Evolution' world tour to Singapore this March
item.description: GAI Zhou Yan, one of the most influential voices in Chinese rap, is bringing his GAI Evolution 2026 World Tour to Singapore on 7 March. item.description: Apink are heading back on the road. item.title: ENHYPEN’s SUNGHOON to carry Olympic torch at Milano Cortina 2026, ‘SHOUT OUT’ named Team Korea’s cheer song
item.description: ENHYPEN are heading to the Winter Olympics — and not just through song.
